name: Card-testing burst on /v1/payments
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, MIN(user) AS user, ip, MIN(asset) AS asset, 'Card testing: '||COUNT(*)||' failed micro-payments in 5 min' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='payment' AND ok=0 AND amount<2 GROUP BY ip, ts/300 HAVING COUNT(*)>=15
desc: Many failed micro-value payments from one IP in 5 minutes - classic card testing.

name: Account takeover: impossible travel
sql: SELECT a.ts AS ts, a.user AS user, a.ip AS ip, a.asset AS asset, 'Logins from '||b.country||' then '||a.country||' within '||((a.ts-b.ts)/60)||' min' AS detail FROM events a JOIN events b ON b.user=a.user AND b.etype='login' AND b.ok=1 AND b.country<>a.country AND b.ts<a.ts AND a.ts-b.ts<3600 WHERE a.etype='login' AND a.ok=1
desc: Two successful logins for one user from different countries less than an hour apart.

name: Credential stuffing on /login
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, 'multiple ('||COUNT(DISTINCT user)||' users)' AS user, ip, MIN(asset) AS asset, COUNT(*)||' failed logins in 10 min' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='login' AND ok=0 GROUP BY ip, ts/600 HAVING COUNT(*)>=25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT user)>=10
desc: Many failed logins across many accounts from one IP in 10 minutes.

name: SIM-swap followed by wallet drain
sql: SELECT p.ts AS ts, p.user AS user, p.ip AS ip, p.asset AS asset, 'SIM swap then payout of '||CAST(p.amount AS INTEGER)||' within '||((p.ts-s.ts)/60)||' min' AS detail FROM events s JOIN events p ON p.user=s.user AND p.etype='payout' AND p.ts>s.ts AND p.ts-s.ts<1800 AND p.amount>=5000 WHERE s.etype='sim_swap'
desc: A SIM swap followed by a payout of 5,000 or more within 30 minutes.

name: Merchant API key used from new country
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, user, MIN(ip) AS ip, MIN(asset) AS asset, 'Merchant API key used from '||MIN(country)||' ('||COUNT(*)||' calls)' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='api' AND user LIKE 'merchant_%' AND country<>'EG' GROUP BY user, ts/3600
desc: Merchant API key used from outside Egypt.

name: Admin VPN login outside working hours
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Admin VPN login at local hour '||strftime('%H', ts, 'unixepoch', '+2 hours') AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='vpn' AND ok=1 AND user LIKE 'admin%' AND CAST(strftime('%H', ts, 'unixepoch', '+2 hours') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 5
desc: Administrator VPN login between 00:00 and 05:59 Cairo time.

name: Mass KYC document download
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, user, MIN(ip) AS ip, 'kyc-portal' AS asset, COUNT(*)||' KYC records read in 1 hour' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='kyc_read' GROUP BY user, ts/3600 HAVING COUNT(*)>=100
desc: One user read 100+ KYC records in an hour.

name: Core DB query spike by service account
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, user, MIN(ip) AS ip, MIN(asset) AS asset, 'Service account pulled '||CAST(SUM(amount) AS INTEGER)||' rows in 10 min' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='db_query' AND user LIKE 'svc_%' GROUP BY user, ts/600 HAVING SUM(amount)>=1000000
desc: Service account pulled over 1,000,000 rows in 10 minutes.

name: Webhook tampering on merchant API
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Webhook changed to '||detail AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='webhook_change' AND detail LIKE 'external:%'
desc: Merchant webhook URL changed to an external, non-registered domain.

name: Failed MFA flood (push fatigue)
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, user, MIN(ip) AS ip, MIN(asset) AS asset, COUNT(*)||' failed MFA prompts in 10 min' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='mfa' AND ok=0 GROUP BY user, ts/600 HAVING COUNT(*)>=8
desc: 8 or more failed MFA prompts for one user in 10 minutes.

name: Mobile gateway scraping bot
sql: SELECT MAX(ts) AS ts, 'anonymous' AS user, ip, 'mobile-gw' AS asset, COUNT(*)||' requests in 5 min' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='api' AND asset='mobile-gw' GROUP BY ip, ts/300 HAVING COUNT(*)>=120
desc: 120+ requests to the mobile gateway from one IP in 5 minutes.

name: New admin role granted
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Role grant: '||detail AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='role_grant' AND detail LIKE '%admin%'
desc: An admin role was granted to an account.

name: Dormant account sudden payout
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Payout of '||CAST(amount AS INTEGER)||' from dormant account' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='payout' AND detail LIKE '%dormant%' AND amount>=3000
desc: Payout of 3,000 or more from an account flagged dormant for 90 days.

name: TOR exit node login
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Login from TOR exit node' AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='login' AND detail LIKE 'tor_exit%'
desc: Successful customer login from a TOR exit node.

name: Suspicious process on payment host
sql: SELECT ts AS ts, user AS user, ip AS ip, asset AS asset, 'Suspicious process: '||detail AS detail FROM events WHERE etype='proc' AND detail IN ('mimikatz','powershell -enc','nc -e','certutil -urlcache')
desc: Known attacker tooling executed on a payment host.
